tools.name: governor_record
tools.description: Record a capacity event (surface merge|checkout|ci_minutes|submission, units) for an operator on a project. Requires an active Meter + Verdicts subscription. Project cap checked before per-operator budget; denied events consume no budget.

tools.name: governor_log
tools.description: Read back a project's hash-chained attempt log with chain verification.

tools.name: governor_stats
tools.description: Concentration stats for a project (top-operator share, HHI per surface and overall).

tools.name: verdict_submit
tools.description: Submit a change receipt for a pre-triage verdict ($0.01/verdict x402 after the one-time 100-verdict grant; included on subscription).

tools.name: verdict_queue
tools.description: Ranked verdict queue for a project (score desc, FIFO tie-break).

tools.name: proxy_checkout
tools.description: Scoped sparse checkout through the stock-git proxy ($0.01/proxied checkout x402; requires an active Meter + Verdicts subscription). Scope paths rejecting '.', '..', absolute and '.git/' are refused.

tools.name: review_record
tools.description: Record an ACTUAL human review measurement for a verdict: queue (verdict_first|fifo), reviewer_minutes spent, human_decision (land|reject), reviewer_id (the attested human reviewer; must differ from the verdict's operator). Requires the Meter + Verdicts subscription. Feeds the measured reviewer-time

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "review_record" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
